voice: ElevenLabs eleven_v4, Jack (BVPhWQykET1TSvfGzrUr), English, one take, split into lines, inner pauses capped at 0.22 s, atempo 1.03

lines.text: My brother works nights in a hospital mortuary. I stayed with him for two nights, in the cold room.
lines.beat_before: hook: the light surges back on a sheeted body sitting upright on the near tray, facing the lens; black

lines.text: The power cuts out all the time. Then it's black, until the generator comes back.
lines.beat_before: the cold room, locked wide: trays of covered dead, my brother at the desk, me on a chair

lines.text: The first time it came back, one of the sheets had slipped.
lines.beat_before: the power dies; black; the generator coughs and the light surges back green, then cyan

lines.text: My brother covered it again without looking. He said, you don't look at them when the light is off.
lines.beat_before: a sheet has slipped: a grey arm hangs off a tray; my brother walks over and covers it

lines.text: The third time, one of them was sitting up. By the door. The stitches down its chest had pulled open.
lines.beat_before: black again; back: nothing changed; black again; back: one sits up by the door, chest open (stinger)

lines.text: He said it was gas. Bodies do that. He laid it back down... and his hands were shaking.
lines.beat_before: he lays it down, hands on its shoulders

lines.text: The second night, the generator didn't come back. I turned on my torch.
lines.beat_before: the second night; the power dies; the generator fails

lines.text: Every covered head in that room had turned toward me.
lines.beat_before: my torch sweeps the trays: every covered head is turned to me

lines.text: In the morning, he counted the register twice. Fourteen brought in. Fifteen in the room.
lines.beat_before: morning: the register; the room in grey daylight, a fifteenth body on the floor
